name: Voxel World Map Data Layout
definition: The world geometry is represented as a discrete 3D grid of integers. A value of 0 denotes empty space; non-zero values denote solid voxels or texture indices.
summary: Voxel World Map Data Layout flattens a 3D voxel grid into a 1D array using a Z-Y-X row-major order, differing from standard X-Y-Z layouts for efficient linear memory access.
